title: Brachypodium GWAS-Spaceflight Integration: Connecting Gravitropic Reorientation Natural Variation with ISS Microgravity Transcriptomics (OSD-375)
description: Integration of Brachypodium distachyon natural genetic variation and GWAS (gravitropic reorientation, root architecture, abiotic stress) with NASA Open Science Data Repository (OSDR) spaceflight transcriptomics data (OSD-375 / APEX-06). Uses machine learning, differential expression, meta-analysis, and knowledge graphs to identify conserved and monocot-specific spaceflight response loci.
